plainText:
Pocket Monsters AG (Korean: 포켓몬스터 Poketmonseuteo AG) is the first opening theme for the Korean dub of Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire. It debuted in AG001, replacing . The first version heavily uses footage from the Japanese opening, Advance Adventure. From AG093 onward, footage from Challenger!! is used instead. The full version of this song can be found on the CD Pocket Monsters AG (New & Best).

==Opening Animation Version 1==
===Synopsis===
 and are standing in a battlefield as the series logo appears. Then, and fly to a battlefield and pass Ash and Pikachu. The screen then divided into three smaller images; one showing Latias and Latios flying, another showing Pikachu, and the last showing , and .

Then, Ash throws two Poké Balls into the sky and calls out and to fight against and . The screen again splits into three smaller images; one showing Treecko and Taillow running, another showing , and the last showing a group of Pokémon. The scene enlarges to show Treecko and Taillow battling Vigoroth and Pelipper. Then, Ash calls Pikachu to use against .

The screen divides into three smaller images; one showing , , and ; another showing ; and the last showing , , and . 

Then, it shows with Team Magma, and then, and Team Aqua appear. The camera then jumps to with , , Meowth, and . 

Ash, , May, and Max are sitting on a raft in the ocean, with several s flying in the sky. Water fills the screen and under the water there are , , , and . Ash and the gang are then in a forest with , , , and . Next they are inside a cave with and .

Max is holding a PokéNav with Ash and his friends behind him, looking at Lilycove City. Ash and his friends run away as the ground disappears and lava flows into the ocean. The camera cuts to jumping into the sky and using . The animation ends with a still image of Ash and the gang standing together with Treecko, Mudkip, Torchic and Pikachu.

==Opening Animation Version 2==
===Synopsis===
The series logo shows up on the screen before the screen splits in half to show Ash and Pikachu running across a grassy plain. The scene grows smaller and eventually fades as other snippets of footage of Ash's Pokémon and friends appear on the screen. 

The scene changes to show Ash and May in a tag battle using Pikachu and Combusken. Pikachu avoids Hariyama's and uses on it. 

Then, Professor Oak appears, with Tracey and Delia behind him. The camera cuts to show Nurse Joy and Officer Jenny starting to pose, before Brock jumps between them, surprising them. Max falls down onto Brock's shoulders and pulls on his ears.

Next, the scene shows flying up into the sky, obviously displeased. May then twirls with Beautifly flying around her.

Ash and Pikachu stand on a tall rock, looking at the night sky. The aurora is active. 

The camera cuts to Swellow using and then into Ash and Pikachu jumping into the sky.

The scene changes to Ash, May, Brock, Max, and all their Pokémon run down a dirt road toward the camera. Swellow flies towards the screen. Then, Ash, May, Brock, Max, and Pikachu sit on a hill overlooking a town. Pikachu stretches.

The camera pans across Ash and his friends, as Max waves his hand in the air.
The series logo is shown, then a still shot of Ash, May, Brock, Max, and Pikachu appears.

==Lyrics==
===TV Size===
 
! Korean
! English

 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 

Keep looking over me as I travel through this arduous road
Even though sometimes we become rivals and fight,
Try to smile for the friendship we have towards each other (Pokémon AG)
Send out a dazzling light, this moment forever~! (Pokémon AG)

Gallantly, more boldly, with courage and with more strength
Open your chest and feel me, who is different from yesterday
I keep running for the tomorrow that will shine brightly
Pokémon friends 

===Full Version===
 
! Korean
! English

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 

A time for a never-ending adventure is awaiting us
Have faith in each other and face one another (Pokémon AG)

My friends, who I meet in a far, unfamiliar place,
Keep looking over me as I travel through this arduous road
Even though sometimes we become rivals and fight,
Try to smile for the friendship we have towards each other (Pokémon AG)
We, who dream, send out a dazzling light
Fly high up into the sky, this moment forever (Pokémon AG)

Gallantly, more boldly, with courage and with more strength
Open your chest and feel me, who is different from yesterday
I keep running for the tomorrow that will shine brightly

I want to show you myself, who has become stronger than yesterday
As we look upon the red-stained sunset, promise for tomorrow (AG)
Lean on my shoulders when you are tired or when you want to rest
Stay beside me, not changing the spirit you've had since the start (Pokémon AG)
I want to cherish your pupils, which will shine like gems
Us, who grow in adventures, let's fulfill our dreams (Pokémon AG)

Gallantly, more boldly, with courage and with more strength
Open your chest and feel me, who is different from yesterday
I keep running for the tomorrow that will shine brightly
Pokémon friends
